systems.owner: Ministry of Education of Liberia (national EMIS unit)

note: No fact: the request for proposal of 14 May 2026 names Liberia's EMIS without describing what it does, so it is unclassified. It states that Liberia has no formal National EMIS Policy and that UNESCO-IICBA, with GPE-KIX funds, is hiring a firm to draft and validate one by 20 August 2026.
